role: Historical exploratory description of the rejected quiet-v1 candidate; not an acceptance gate

commonProcessing.method: causal first-order recurrence, initialized to first sample; one second excluded at both ends
commonProcessing.tpRule: existing features.py: preceding energy peak +0.55RR to next peak -max(0.25RR,220ms); >=30ms
commonProcessing.driftMetric: STD/range of per-window TP medians; not a pure isolated artifact measurement

interpretation: Quiet-v1 is cleaner but does not improve resemblance uniformly: I/II HF noise is already close to this real cohort under resting-v1; quiet-v1 moves below it.
V2 HF amplitude is closer to this small real cohort under quiet-v1; this is not proof of better clinical realism.
V2 variation in heuristic TP medians persists with ideal acquisition; neither the whole variation nor all visible irregularity can be attributed to the additive noise floor.
Engineering rejection is determined separately by the preregistered morphology/analysis gates. These descriptive results must not override it.
limitations: Original recorder filtering and synthetic antialias are not the same acquisition chain.
TP windows are heuristic, not independently annotated T/P boundaries; some residual physiological content can remain.
NORM-only exploratory reference cannot validate disease morphology.
Synthetic reserve means predeclared seeds only, not independently acquired patients.
No parameter selection based on these results; factor0.5 fixed beforehand.
No clinical reviewer and no clinical plausibility upgrade.
selectionHashNote: SHA of the portable committed selection with LF endings; original and reproduced report hashes retain the exact historical bytes, including their input-line-ending provenance.
